name: Whimsy Shaman Spirit
body:
A shaman who selects the whimsy spirit is playful and unpredictable, with odd streaks of color in her skin, eyes, and hair, that dance in the air without any breeze. Her feet seem to barely touch the ground and her laughter is silvery and eerie.

Spirit Magic Spells: faerie fire (1st), hideous laughter (2nd), shamefully overdressed (3rd), major image (4th), lesser entice fey (5th), mislead (6th), entice fey (7th), irresistible dance (8th), greater entice fey (9th).

Hexes: A shaman who chooses the Whimsy spirit can select from the following hexes.

Curse of Ridicule (Su)

The shaman curses a creature within 30 feet so that it cannot be taken seriously.

Everyone interacting with the cursed creature behaves as if under the effect of an absurdity spell, except that only the target is perceived as ridicule, and the affected creatures do not suffer penalties on Sense Motive or Initiative checks. This curse lasts for a number of rounds equal to the shaman’s level. A creature affected by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.

Fey Sight (Su)

The shaman can see through underbrush and plant growth that would normally grant concealment, up to a range of 60 feet (though darkness and other obstacles still may block her sight). At 7th level, she can spot invisible creatures (as see invisibility) in the same radius.

Fey Summons (Su)

Whenever the shaman calls or summons one or more creatures, one creature of her choice arrives with the fey creature template. Such a creature is glimmering and more fascinating than other members of its species (+2 bonus on Charisma).

Flicker (Sp)

The shaman can flicker from sight for a short time, allowing her to escape or set up a prank. As a swift action, the shaman can disappear for 1 round per level. This ability functions as invisibility. The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to half her level (minimum 1).

Whimsical Prank (Su)

As a standard action, the shaman can call upon fey to play a prank on a creature within 30 feet as a dirty trick combat maneuver. This attempt is resolved as normal, except that it doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity, the shaman uses her class level in place of her Combat Maneuver Bonus, and adds her Charisma modifier in place of her Strength or Dexterity modifier. No save is allowed against this attempt. Once affected by this hex, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Spirit Animal: The shaman’s spirit animal has an unusual color pattern and eyes of a vivid yellow or purple, sparkling in the dark. It can disguise self at will, as the spell.

Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the Whimsy spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability.

Fey Bargain (Ex)

The shaman gains the Conditional Spell metamagic feat as a bonus feat and can apply it to a spell without increasing its spell level for a number of times per day equal to her Charisma bonus.

Greater Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the Whimsy spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the greater version of that spirit.

Capricious Misdirection (Sp)

The shaman’s ever-changing nature allows her to misdirect aura-reading divinations with ease. The shaman is constantly under the effects of a misdirection spell, except that she can take a standard action to select a creature or object within 60 feet to serve as the target of detection spells used against her until she selects a different creature or object.

True Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the Whimsy spirit as her spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the true version of that spirit.

Assumed Form (Sp)

The shaman can change her appearance at will, as alter self with a caster level equal to her shaman level. This ability lasts until the shaman dismisses it or uses it again, allowing her to keep it active while she sleeps.

Manifestation: Upon reaching 20th level, the shaman becomes a fey trickster in the flesh. Her type changes to fey and she gains low-light vision, immunity to poison, and DR 10/cold iron.
